justification: Panel A shows schematic line figures of boats with crews, standing humans with staffs, sun-like discs and animal tracks arranged sparsely across a flat surface, while panel B shows deeply relief-carved, layered bands of stylized animals stacked in registers with no boats or human figures visible. The only loose correspondence is the general presence of animal-like forms, but their specific type, posture, and relationship to other elements differ entirely, and the compositional logic (sparse scattered scene vs. dense stacked registers) is not comparable.
